title: New Inventory Part opens with Description then Part Number, no library pick
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • No part numbered {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TYPED-01) exists at {Location-A}, on the Active or the Inactive tab.
  • The description you will type is {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL TYPED PART).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click into the first field of the window and type {Description-A}.
  3. Press Tab once and type {Part-A}.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
  7. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a window titled "New Inventory Part" opens. Its first field is "Description" and the next field is "Part Number". There is no Part Library (or Catalog Part) field anywhere in the window, and no lookup list opens.
  • Step 2: the first field, Description, holds the text exactly as typed.
  • Step 3: Tab moves the cursor from Description to Part Number, and Part Number holds {Part-A} as plain typed text, with no list to pick from.
  • Step 6: the window closes and the part is saved. No Part Library step was asked for.
  • Step 7: one row shows Description {Description-A} and Part Number {Part-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-R1, S7-R2, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), board 1.3 (Number and description typed), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R1: “The New Inventory Part dialog has a Description field, followed by a Part Number field. Both are free text.”
  • S7-R2: “The dialog has no Part Library selector and no Part Library lookup step.”
